results.bank-native: 256-round control comparison before u128 wrapper migration
results.smoke256: 256-round iterator/exp_list/inert type_list/aligned receiver tests before u128 wrapper migration
results.smoke512: 512-round receiver tests before u128 wrapper migration
results.shared-native: 256-round control comparison after u128 wrapper migration
results.shared-smoke512: 512-round receiver tests after u128 wrapper migration

notes: All generators are index_sequence_istream; no input type lists or meta_istream are used.
Default medium smoke uses meta_iterator; aligned receiver does not accumulate a type list.
Legacy control reference preserves old wide stage/failure operations, but shares existing timer helpers and the current outer looper infrastructure.
Control baseline is an algorithm comparison in the same build, not a completely frozen pre-change library.
Fixed case order and separate measurement batches permit timing drift; do not attribute all before/after smoke timing changes to the kernel.
Final u128 control medians improve approximately 3.1 percent GCC and 3.5 percent Clang versus the same-build legacy control; peak memory changes are small.
Inert type_list provides no material improvement over exp_list at 256 or 512 rounds with no list member evaluation.
Actual deep_smoke already uses integer generators and iterator receivers on its main paths; its ostream only collects a final flushed result.
Deep smoke was not executed because the inert-list improvement condition was not met.
